items.description: Write SEO-optimized blog content and landing pages for the agency's client accounts across health, finance, and SaaS niches.
responsibilities: Conduct keyword research and search intent analysis for each brief
Write long-form blog posts of 1,500 to 3,000 words
Optimize existing content for target keywords using Surfer SEO
Coordinate with editors and SEO strategists on internal linking
achievements: Helped 6 client articles reach page 1 of Google within 90 days
Maintained a 98% on-time delivery rate across 60+ articles

items.description: Create SEO-driven destination guides and trip-planning content for a travel platform, combining search intent, thorough research, and engaging storytelling to help travelers make informed decisions.
responsibilities: Research and write destination guides targeting relevant long-tail keywords and search intent.
Develop content around topic clusters and SEO briefs in collaboration with the SEO team.
Refresh and optimize existing content to improve rankings, relevance, and organic visibility.
Conduct competitor and SERP research to identify content gaps and ranking opportunities.
Optimize content structure, headings, internal links, meta titles, and meta descriptions.
achievements: Contributed to a 40% increase in organic traffic to the travel guides section.
Authored 3 of the website’s highest-traffic articles.
Consistently produced research-driven content aligned with both SEO goals and reader intent.
